---
name: Verification report
about: Record a bounded check of a mathematical or computational claim
title: 'Verification: '
---

## Claim and exact source

Investigation, version/commit, proposition/equation, hypotheses and scope.

## Method and independence

Definitions and primary sources used; shared premises; actual reviewer/tool
configuration where available.

## Result and limits

What was checked, evidence or counterexample, and what remains unchecked.

## Proposed register update

Task ID and evidence path; do not claim completion beyond the check performed.
